 DAX Performance Index Retreats From 26,692 Record as Fear & Greed Hits 21
 Article produced with artificial intelligence systems and published under the editorial responsibility of Amelia Tomasicchio. How we work 
 By Satoshi Voice 6 November 2026, 14:11 2 min read In Trading 
 DAX performance index pulls back from record high amid tech sell-off 
 Share X Telegram WhatsApp LinkedIn Email 
 European equities experienced selling pressure as global technology stocks retreated, causing the DAX performance index to pull back from its newest peak.
 Despite reaching a record level during Thursday trading, heavy tech selling in the United States dragged the German benchmark lower by the market close.
 Summary
 US Tech Sell-Off Pressures German Stocks 
 Technical Analysis of the DAX Performance Index 
 Fear & Greed Index Signals Extreme Fear 
 US Tech Sell-Off Pressures German Stocks 
 Germany’s major stock benchmark touched an all-time peak of 26,692.9 points on Thursday before market momentum reversed. The index subsequently extended losses into the close , finishing down roughly 0.4% compared to the previous day’s close, at approximately 26,325 points .
 Advertisement 
 This retreat was primarily driven by external spillovers from United States equity markets, where major technology indices suffered significant declines led by severe chip-related losses.
 Despite the negative cues from Wall Street, analysts noted that European markets showed greater resilience than their American counterparts. Because there are relatively few large artificial intelligence companies within the German index, the direct impact of the US tech sell-off remained somewhat contained.
 Technical Analysis of the DAX Performance Index 
 From a chart perspective, market participants are watching key technical support and resistance levels closely. Traded prices are now testing the critical 26,000-point area as pre-market focus shifts lower. If weakness persists, technical coverage highlights secondary support situated around 25,900 points .
 To restore sustained upward momentum, buyers need to reclaim and hold above the record high threshold of 26,692 points . A successful breakout above this pivot could unlock higher technical targets, with chart projections pointing toward 27,500 points and potentially 28,150 points .
 Fear & Greed Index Signals Extreme Fear 
 Broader sentiment metrics reflect growing anxiety among market participants following the sudden pull-back from record highs. The Fear & Greed Index recently dropped into EXTREME FEAR territory, recording a reading of 21 .
 Investors are currently monitoring short-term catalysts and macroeconomic updates to evaluate whether the recent price decline represents a brief consolidation or the start of a deeper correction. How the DAX performance index handles immediate support zones will likely determine market direction in upcoming sessions.
